entities.summary: Rosina Randafiarison is a weightlifter from Madagascar. She is the silver medalist of 2023 World Championships and the first ever world medalist in any Olympic sport from Madagascar. Rosina Randafiarison was a athletes & competitors from Mahajanga (b. 1999-12-29, Mahajanga). Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
